string-array.name: couch_warning_bodies
string-array.item: BEFORE WATCHING, CONFIRM SNACKS ARE WITHIN ARM\'S REACH AND THE REMOTE HAS NOT BEEN LOST IN THE CUSHIONS.
COUCH 3 IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR \"JUST ONE MORE EPISODE.\" PLEASE BLINK OCCASIONALLY AND STAND UP AT LEAST ONCE PER SEASON.
SWEATPANTS RECOMMENDED. BLANKETS ARE SHARED PROPERTY. WHOEVER PAUSES FOR A BATHROOM BREAK GETS THE NEXT SNACK.
MEMBERS WHO FALL ASLEEP FORFEIT THEIR RIGHT TO COMPLAIN ABOUT WHAT THEY MISSED. NO RECAPS WILL BE PROVIDED.
CALL YOUR BOYFRIEND OR GIRLFRIEND NOW, BEFORE YOU START DOOMSCROLLING SLOP AND FORGET TO CALL THEM BACK. COUCH 3 WILL NOT COVER FOR YOU.
COUCH 3 HAS CONFIRMED THAT ALEX SMELLS GOOD. PLEASE ADJUST YOUR SEATING ACCORDINGLY.

string-array.name: couch_warning_prompts
string-array.item: Press OK if you already called.

resources.string: IT IS PAST MIDNIGHT. COUCH 3 RECOMMENDS GOING TO BED. COUCH 3 KNOWS YOU WON\'T.
